RED RAINFALL WARNING SA METRO MANILA, RIZAL, LAGUNA

Naglabas ng Red Rainfall Warning ang National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC) dakong 6:46 ng gabi ngayong Linggo, Nobyembre 9, para sa Metro Manila, Rizal at Laguna.

Sa ilalim ng Red Rainfall Warning, pinag-iingat ang publiko laban sa malakas na ulan, posibleng pagbaha, at landslide.

(Courtesy: NDRRMC)

#PilipinasToday
#UwanPH
#NDRRMC
#MetroManila #NCR
#Rizal #Laguna

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 6 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Cyclone UWAN
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 09 November 2025(Sunday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Rizal, Metro Manila, Laguna, Bulacan, Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Tiaong, General Nakar, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Burdeos, Calauag, Guinayangan, Jomalig, Padre Burgos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Perez, Plaridel, Polillo, Quezon, Tagkawayan, Sariaya, Lopez, General Luna, Gumaca, Pitogo, Unisan, Macalelon, Catanauan, Buenavista) and Cavite(Cavite City, Carmona, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Dasmarinas, Imus, Bacoor, Kawit, Silang, Noveleta, General Trias, Rosario, Tanza, Trece Martires).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Batangas, Pampanga, Tarlac, Nueva Ecija, Zambales, Cavite(Alfonso, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Indang, Magallanes, Maragondon, Mendez, Tagaytay, Ternate, Amadeo, Naic), Quezon(Mulanay, San Narciso, San Francisco, San Andres) and Bataan(Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Orani, Samal, Abucay).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan(Bagac, Balanga, Limay, Mariveles, Morong, Orion, Pilar).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.text:
‘BUKAS PO ANG SIMBAHAN’

As Super Typhoon #UwanPH batters the country, the Santa Lucia Parish in Novaliches, Quezon City opens its doors on Sunday, Nov. 9, to provide refuge for residents seeking higher ground from rising floodwaters.

“Bukas po ang Simbahan ng Santa Lucia upang patuluyin ang ating mga kapatid nasalanta ng baha dahil sa bagyong Uwan,” the parish said on its Facebook page.

Rev. Fr. Marvin Riquez, parish priest of Santa Lucia, said they will also serve hot meals to evacuees and have mobilized parish volunteers to assist in the relief efforts. (📸: SANTA LUCIA PARISH FB PAGE) | via Jel Santos

Mayor Maan Teodoro said that the local government is fully mobilized to assist residents evacuating from the storm and is ready to respond to any emergencies. (Contributed photos) | via Richielyn Canlas
